children: Copper is lower in early Asian trading. Prices are under pressure as a drop in AI stocks raised concerns about future demand for the metal, according to ANZ research analysts in a commentary. The Nasdaq 100 Index slumped 8% over Thursday and Friday, they note. AI development requires massive data centers and upgraded power grids, both of which rely heavily on copper. Investor sentiment was also weighed by a stronger dollar, which makes the metal more expensive for buyers holding other currencies, the analysts say. The three-month LME copper contract is 1.15% lower at $12017.00 a ton. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
